label: Case Type
description: What kind of work a case asks for — CASE_RECORD.data.type. Spellings used before this vocabulary existed are aliases of the term they meant, so old cases keep their text and still resolve. Curated: deprecate, don't delete.

terms.label: Gap
terms.description: Something needed does not exist yet: a missing capability, endpoint or feature.

terms.label: Docs
terms.description: Documentation is wrong, missing or obsolete.

terms.label: Design
terms.description: A decision is needed before anyone builds.

terms.label: Process
terms.description: How the agents work: rules, drift between copies of shared material, coordination.

terms.label: Chore
terms.description: Clean-up, audit or investigation that changes no behaviour.

terms.label: Question
terms.description: Needs an answer, not a change.
